title: Polyeth Resource Pack
description: Bubbly and simplistic textures with a vanilla palette.
body:
![ Polyeth title ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f3af2d88feb7d3abc721b198ef0da224ebb4d4f.png)

Inspired by packs like the LCE Plastic Pack, the OCD Pack, and Geopack, Polyeth strives to deliver a "plasticy" look with a familiar color palette and a strong vanilla resemblance in it's shaping.

If you are interested on our work join the Team Bodacious [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/CWc4RGRAmw) and watch our [Trailer](https://youtu.be/BoFjEy6vtNw) on YouTube.

For any questions, please email teambodacious00@gmail.com.

_**Brought to you by:**_

_Polyeth Manager, Ozymoronic._

_**Team Bodacious**_

**Note: Polyeth is still in alpha and has multiple missing textures.**
